 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Michael Olise has built a compelling case for the Ballon d'Or 2026 after an outstanding season with Bayern Munich. The France international combined goalscoring with exceptional creativity, helping Bayern win three domestic trophies while earning recognition as the Bundesliga's Player of the Season.
 According to the official Ballon d'Or nominee statistics , Olise recorded 27 goals and 35 assists in 69 appearances across the 2025–26 season. His Bundesliga performances were particularly impressive. He scored 15 goals and provided 19 assists. This made him the first player since Jadon Sancho in 2019–20 to register at least 15 goals and 15 assists in a single Bundesliga campaign, according to the Bundesliga's official report .
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Olise faces a difficult challenge from Harry Kane, whose goalscoring record gives him a different argument for the award. He is also up against Barcelona winger Lamine Yamal, who also delivered an impressive attacking season.
 Here are three reasons Olise deserves serious consideration for football's most prestigious individual award.
 1. Olise's 62 Goal Contributions Demonstrate His Attacking Influence
 Soccer Football – FIFA World Cup 2026 – Bronze Final – France v England – Miami Stadium, Miami Gardens, Florida, U.S. – July 18, 2026 France's Kylian Mbappe and Michael Olise react after England's Bukayo Saka scores their fifth goal IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters/Sam Navarro
 Olise's statistics are the strongest starting point for his Ballon d'Or candidacy. His 27 goals and 35 assists across 69 appearances amount to 62 direct goal contributions. Those numbers demonstrate his ability to influence matches as both a scorer and a creator. The Bundesliga figures provide even clearer evidence of his impact. Olise finished the league campaign with 15 goals and 19 assists, leading the competition in assists and earning the Player of the Season award.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The distinction matters because Olise does not depend solely on finishing chances. Operating primarily from the right, he can carry the ball towards the penalty area, beat defenders one-on-one and create shooting opportunities through his left-footed passing. His ability to create chances while remaining a scoring threat gives Bayern multiple ways to attack. Opponents must account for his delivery into the box as well as his willingness to cut inside and attempt shots himself.
 Olise's influence was particularly evident in Bayern's 6–2 victory over Freiburg. According to the Bundesliga's match analysis , he scored twice and provided three assists after Bayern had fallen 2–0 behind. That performance offers more than a season-total statistic: it demonstrates how he can change a match through both scoring and creating goals.
 Impressive production does not, however, automatically make him the strongest candidate. Olise must still be compared with players who have delivered different combinations of individual output and team success.
 2. Bayern's Trophy Haul Strengthens Olise's Candidacy
 The second argument for Olise is his contribution to Bayern Munich's successful campaign.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The official nominee list credits Olise with the Bundesliga, German Cup, and German Super Cup. Winning three domestic trophies provides a strong foundation for his candidacy, particularly when considered alongside his individual statistics. His Bundesliga Player of the Season award offers further recognition. The official Bayern announcement highlighted his consistency and attacking influence throughout the campaign.
 That recognition distinguishes Olise from a player whose reputation rests on isolated performances. His production remained significant across the season, helping Bayern sustain an effective attack. Nevertheless, trophies must be assessed alongside individual performances. A player does not automatically deserve the Ballon d'Or because his team wins more competitions.
 The award's official regulations place individual performances and their decisive, impressive character first, followed by collective performances and trophies won, then class and fair play. Olise's case therefore depends on more than Bayern's domestic success. His personal contribution must remain central to the argument.
 3. Olise's Creative Ability Gives Him A Different Case Against Kane and Yamal

 The figures reveal three different attacking profiles.
 Kane has the clearest advantage in goalscoring, with 73 goals in 65 appearances. Yamal combines 25 goals with 20 assists, while Olise recorded the highest assist total of the three. Olise's 35 assists are particularly significant. They show that his contribution extends beyond finishing and that he regularly creates opportunities for teammates.
 Soccer Football – FIFA World Cup 2026 – Final – Spain v Argentina – New York/New Jersey Stadium, East Rutherford, New Jersey, U.S. – July 19, 2026 
Spain's Lamine Yamal in action with Argentina's Nicolas Tagliafico IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters/James Lang
 Kane's 81 goal contributions exceed Olise's 62, despite Kane making four fewer appearances. That is a substantial statistical advantage for the Bayern striker. Yamal's case is different again. His combination of goals and assists is supported by Barcelona's domestic success and Spain's World Cup triumph, as listed in the official nominee data. Olise must therefore make a more specific argument. His creative production, goalscoring contribution, and role in Bayern's success make him a serious candidate, even though Kane leads in total goal contributions.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Whether that combination is enough depends on how voters evaluate individual influence alongside team achievements.
 End Of My Ballon D'Or 2026 Rant: Does Michael Olise Deserve The Ballon D'Or 2026?
 Olise has a strong case for consideration, but his statistics alone do not make him the obvious winner. His 27 goals and 35 assists across 69 appearances, three domestic trophies and Bundesliga Player of the Season award demonstrate the scale of his campaign. His performance against Freiburg also provides a concrete example of his ability to influence a match through both goalscoring and chance creation.
 Kane's 73 goals and 81 total goal contributions give the England striker a clear statistical advantage. Yamal also has a strong argument built around his individual output and international success. The Ballon d'Or decision will depend on how voters assess each nominee against the award's criteria, particularly individual performances and decisive contributions.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Olise's strongest argument is his exceptional creative output combined with his own goalscoring and domestic success. He deserves to be taken seriously in the debate, but his rivals have substantial evidence in their favour as well.
